import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polygon(6, 15.012)
    .extrude(15.0)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(8.0)
    .faces("<Z").edges("%LINE").chamfer(2.0, 2.0)
    .union(cq.Workplane("XY").polygon(6, 15.012).extrude(2.0).faces(">Z").workplane().hole(8.0))
)
show_object(result)
